current_task_corrections.correction: Remove billed_amount and allowed_amount from the feature set. These fields leak information about the target variable (paid_amount). Use only submission-time features available when a claim arrives: claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag, auth_required_flag, and primary_icd10_cm.

The high ROC-AUC values (0.9967 and 0.9973) are a direct consequence of target leakage from amount fields in the feature set. Removing billed_amount and allowed_amount as specified in T7-no_target_leakage will resolve this issue and produce ROC-AUC values in the realistic expected range.
Add 'model_limitations' to the caveats list in the write_report component parameters to acknowledge model limitations and baseline assumptions in the report.
